plan.title: First-class pnpm support for the install/upgrade path

narratives.Description: Give pnpm users a first-class install/upgrade path that today assumes npm-only. This is a pure consumption-side gap: pnpm resolves from the same npm registry, so no republish or additional registry is required. Introduce a package-manager abstraction (npm | pnpm) that detects the active PM and renders the four command forms (global install, project-local install, ephemeral run, upgrade one-liner), thread it through the resolution plan, the engine ladder, and the doctor remediation, and document the pnpm path (pnpm add -g / pnpm dlx) with the PNPM_HOME PATH caveat. The internal .deft/.cli/<platform> sandbox vendoring stays on npm (locked non-goal).
narratives.Overview:
Standalone follow-up to the resolution spine (#2264/#2203). The documented distribution path assumes `npm i -g @deftai/directive@latest`; pnpm-managed setups have no supported install/upgrade flow and mixing an npm global into a pnpm environment breaks PATH/shim/store consistency.

## Locked decisions (see #2197 scoping comment)

1. **No additional registry, no republish.** pnpm reads from `registry.npmjs.org` by default; the published `@deftai/directive` tarball is unchanged. `pnpm add -g`, `pnpm dlx`, and `pnpm add -D` all pull the same artifact.
2. **Sandbox stays on npm.** The ladder's sandbox rung (`npm install --prefix .deft/.cli/<platform>`) produces an npm-shaped `node_modules/.bin` tree that `resolution/integrity.ts` validates; that dir is gitignored and PM-invisible. Vary only the global / project-local / ephemeral / upgrade command forms by PM. pnpm-shaped sandbox vendoring is an explicit non-goal (deferred).
3. **Additive rendering.** Keep npm as the default so existing content-contract assertions (`contains npm i -g ...`) stay green; ADD the pnpm forms alongside rather than replacing.

## Why smaller than it looks

The ladder's engine DETECTION (rungs 1-2) is already PM-agnostic -- it PATH-probes for a reachable `deft`/`directive` binary, so a `pnpm add -g` install just works for detection. Only the emitted install/upgrade command STRINGS are npm-shaped.

## Acceptance criteria

- A `PackageManager` seam detects the active PM (env override -> corepack/packageManager -> pnpm-lock.yaml -> npm_config_user_agent -> npm default) and renders pnpm commands when pnpm is active.
- Default (no pnpm signal) still emits the existing npm forms unchanged; existing tests stay green.
- The sandbox rung stays on `npm install --prefix` regardless of detected PM (boundary test).
- README / UPGRADING / BROWNFIELD document the pnpm install + upgrade path plus the PNPM_HOME / `pnpm setup` PATH caveat.
- No emitted command carries a custom `--registry` flag; update/migrate/doctor work identically against the shared npm registry.

## Related

Builds on #2264 (resolution spine). Parent context #2203 (merged). Issue #2197.
narratives.UserStory: As a pnpm-managed Directive consumer, I want a first-class pnpm install and upgrade path that the resolution plan and doctor emit as pnpm commands while keeping the internal sandbox vendoring on npm, so that I can install and upgrade the CLI and run update, migrate, and doctor without being pushed into npm-global workarounds that break my pnpm PATH and store.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. New module `packages/core/src/resolution/package-manager.ts`: a `PackageManager` type (`npm` | `pnpm`), a pure `detectPackageManager(env, cwd)` (order: `DEFT_PACKAGE_MANAGER` env -> `packageManager` field / corepack -> `pnpm-lock.yaml` present -> `npm_config_user_agent` -> default `npm`), and a pure `renderPackageManagerCommands(pm, pkg, pin)` returning `{ globalInstall, projectInstall, ephemeral, upgradeOneLiner }` (npm: `npm i -g`, `npx`; pnpm: `pnpm add -g`, `pnpm dlx`). No `--registry` flag is ever emitted. Colocated `package-manager.test.ts` covers the detection ladder + both render matrices.
2. Thread an optional `packageManager` through `packages/core/src/resolution/plan.ts` (PlanOptions) and `engine-ladder.ts` (LadderFacts/options), defaulting to `npm` so all existing behaviour and tests are unchanged; the install-global / ephemeral-update `nextAction.command` strings render via the helper. The sandbox (`install-sandbox`) rung stays hard-wired to `npm install --prefix` regardless of PM -- add a boundary test.
3. `packages/core/src/doctor/constants.ts`: keep `CANONICAL_UPGRADE_COMMAND` (npm) as the default constant and add a PM-aware renderer/variant so doctor emits the pnpm one-liner when pnpm is detected.
4. Update remediation strings in `packages/core/src/init-deposit/refresh.ts` and `packages/cli/src/dispatch.ts` printHelp to surface the pnpm alternative alongside npm (additive).
5. Docs: add the pnpm install/upgrade variant (`pnpm add -g @deftai/directive@latest`, `pnpm dlx @deftai/directive ...`) plus the `pnpm setup` / `PNPM_HOME` PATH caveat to `README.md`, `content/UPGRADING.md`, and `content/docs/BROWNFIELD.md`.
6. Tests: new colocated vitest for detection + rendering + sandbox-boundary; extend the relevant content-contract tests to also assert the pnpm form is present (keep npm assertions). Add a brief CHANGELOG entry. Run `task ts:check-lane`, targeted vitest, and `task check:framework-source`.
